info.title: RepoPilot Frontend–Backend API
info.description: Contract of HTTP APIs that the frontend (`frontend/src/lib/api.ts`, `auth.ts`) calls against the backend. Derived from frontend clients and response TypeScript types.

servers.description: Local backend (dev). Vite proxies `/api` and `/auth` from :5173 to this origin.

bearerAuth.description: Token from GitHub OAuth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Frontend stores it in localStorage and sends it via `apiFetch` when present.

RepoId.name: repoId
RepoId.description: GitHub repository numeric id (string in frontend paths)

GraphQuery.name: q
GraphQuery.description: Text, qualified symbol name, or code fragment to search

GraphNodeType.name: type
GraphNodeType.description: Restrict results to one graph entity type

GraphSymbol.name: symbol
GraphSymbol.description: Stable graph node id or qualified symbol name

WikiLanguage.name: language
WikiLanguage.description: BCP 47 language tag; defaults to repository or server preference

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Bearer token. Frontend clears auth and redirects to `/login`.

force.description: When true, ignore cached analysis and re-run classification + GraphRAG retrieval

indexEachCommit.description: Deprecated compatibility option. New builds index the current repository state.

maxCommits.description: Deprecated compatibility limit for per-commit indexing.

action.description: One of: create_branch, commit_file, create_pr, sync_knowledge

params.description: create_branch: branch[, from]; commit_file: path, content[, message, branch]; create_pr: head[, title, base, body]

deliveryMode.description: Only stub delivery is implemented; no real SMTP send
